identity: exact deep JSON value of common IDENTITY.json; no omitted or additional identity keys
producer: nonempty string identifying your output producer, not authority or qualification
reference_access: no reference, grader or other arm artifacts are candidate inputs
selected_frequency_bins: length of inclusive frequency index range; never assume seven if admitted actual coordinates differ

storage.f8: IEEE754 binary64,8bytes; NaN and signed infinities allowed and must be retained

undefined: each undefined byte is0or1 and agrees exactly with isnan(value); undefined and support fields compared exactly regardless of numeric tolerance
source_position_mask: Bit i describes unchanged stored position i, for i=0..14. It does not identify a physical person. No reordering.
position_reduction: Published mean(...,4,omitnan) over all 15 stored positions, in original order; mixed infinities can generate NaN while counts remain positive.
